description: Look up a material from the parts list by words from its name or spec. Returns quantity, unit, spec and which parts use it.

configuration.query: FROM cutonce-materials METADATA _score | WHERE MATCH(raw_text, ?text) | SORT _score DESC | KEEP material_id, name, spec, unit, quantity, used_by | LIMIT 5

text.description: Words from the material's name or spec
